query: This dashboard works but feels flat and generic. Make it feel premium and human without a redesign.
expected_behavior: Improves the existing dashboard with craft details that support its actual tasks rather than adding decoration by default
Adjusts salience so task status and the useful next action are easy to find, allowing multiple legitimate actions to remain visible
Proposes a small number of specific changes tied to the product and brief, without requiring one accent or motion idea
Avoids recognizable generic patterns when they do not serve the page, and explains the task-based reason
Orders refinements so task fit, states, and accessibility remain intact
